items.title: Mary Collins Interview, 1974-09-29
items.q: The interviewee narrates that Joe Robichaud visited Lee Konitz and recorded with him, but does not state a direct personal or professional relationship between herself (Mary Collins) and Joe Robichaud.

ctx.x: And two or three times he was very despondent, you know. Sometimes he didn't want to see his friends. They would come to visit him. And, uh, Mr. Robichaud came to see. Joe Robichaud? Right. Joe. Oh, he admired him, but Mr. Robichaud never took him in the band because he said Lee was a little too wild. And Lee, but Lee really. I'm surprised Joe Robichaud said. Well, at that time, when he was young, he played a different style of music. I'm sorry.
